jobs.title: Program Manager, Customer Onboarding
jobs.description:
PartsSource is the **leading technology and software platform for managing mission\-critical healthcare equipment**. Trusted by over 5,000 US hospitals and 15,000 clinical sites, PartsSource empowers providers and service organizations to maximize clinical availability for patient care and automates the procurement of parts, services and training through a unique digital experience.

  

PartsSource team members are deeply committed to our mission of **Ensuring Healthcare is Always On®**, which is foundational to our success and growth. Our vibrant culture is built upon aligned values, shared ownership, mutual respect, and a passion for collaborating to solve complex customer problems.



About the Job Opportunity



  

The Program Manager owns end\-to\-end delivery of PartsSource's largest and most complex customer programs across enterprise health systems, IDNs, and multi\-site organizations. You lead a matrixed project team spanning Engagement Managers, Implementation Specialists, technical resources, third\-party partners, and cross\-functional teams, holding them accountable to a comprehensive plan.



As the single accountable point of contact for customer executives, you own the integrated program: the cross\-functional workstream plan, dependencies between solutions and third\-party applications, the executive governance structure, and the change management that moves clinical and operational teams to full adoption. You sit in front of health system CFOs, COOs, and C\-suite sponsors, navigating complex environments and establishing trusted relationships at all organizational levels.



Your success is measured by whether the program drives the intended clinical and operational outcomes and by your ability to build and sustain customer relationships that span the entire implementation lifecycle.



What You'll Do



  

Own the Integrated Program Plan



Build and maintain a single master program plan spanning every in\-scope workstream, with defined critical path, sequencing logic, and explicit dependency mapping. Determine the right implementation sequence and identify which workstreams gate others, where parallel execution is safe, and where phasing protects customer stability. Set the program\-level milestone framework and hold each workstream lead accountable to it, escalating slippage before it consumes float. Direct Engagement Managers, Implementation Specialists, and technical resources without formal authority, establishing clear ownership at the workstream level.



Define Program Scope, Commercial Structure \& Effort



Partner with sales, legal, finance, and the customer to translate multi\-solution commercial agreements into coherent delivery scope. Own the master statement of work and its relationship to subordinate SOWs, service descriptions, joinders, and site\-level addenda. Present program scope, structure, assumptions, and dependencies to customer executives for alignment and sign\-off. Size total program effort across workstreams, surface resourcing gaps early, and negotiate capacity. Manage change at the program level by assessing downstream impact of every change request on other workstreams, cost, and go live.



Establish Executive Governance \& Stakeholder Relationships



Design and run the governance model including workstream sessions, program\-level integration cadences, and an executive Steering Committee at the C\-suite level. Produce reporting that consolidates multiple workstreams into a clear view of progress, risk, decisions, and value delivered. Serve as the single accountable point of contact for customer executive sponsors and escalation path for issues crossing workstream boundaries. Build and sustain relationships across HTM, supply chain, clinical engineering, IT, finance, and executive leadership.



Manage Program Risk, Integrations \& Third Parties



Maintain a program\-level risk register identifying risks that emerge from interaction between workstreams, and define mitigation plans with named owners. Coordinate data feeds, interfaces, asset migration, and ERP connections across technical teams and customer IT. Own relationships and delivery dates for OEMs, service providers, vendors, and multi\-party delivery structures. Sequence onsite activity across multiple facilities and geographies, including inventories, deployments, and go live support.



Drive Adoption \& Benefits Realization



Lead change management for multi\-solution implementations. Set measurable criteria for each workstream and program overall; validate adoption and confirm benefits realization before closure. Hold accountability for the program's Customer Onboarding Index (COI) result against the 85%\+ standard. Lead the In\-Market Support phase through a clean transition to Services and Customer Success. Run retrospectives and feed findings back into the implementation methodology.



Partner Across the Organization \& Advance the Practice



Coordinate across solution practices to secure resources and maintain delivery standards. Work integration dependencies, sequencing, and data readiness with Technical Onboarding. Define transitions with Services and Customer Care. Bring recurring program friction to Product and Engineering with evidence to advocate for platform improvements. Build reusable assets including templates, service descriptions, governance models, and sequencing patterns. Coach Engagement Managers and serve as delivery escalation resource across Customer Onboarding.



What You'll Bring



  

Your Background



7\+ years delivering enterprise programs or complex implementations end to end, from scoping through benefits realization, in healthcare, health technology, or adjacent industry.



3\+ years running programs with multiple concurrent workstreams under a single plan with real dependencies on each other.



Demonstrated experience leading matrixed delivery teams without formal authority, including holding peers and senior stakeholders to commitments.



Prior experience with integrating technology solutions into clinical operations to improve clinical and care capacity through formal cross\-functional change management across multi\-disciplinary stakeholders.



Experience with multi\-site or multi\-entity rollouts within health systems, IDNs, or comparable distributed organizations.



Experience managing programs with multiple technical integrations and third\-party applications, vendors, or delivery partners.



Track record of managing complex, multi\-stakeholder client relationships at the VP or C\-suite level.



Strong executive communication and ability to hold a position under pressure: to tell a client what they need to hear rather than what they want to hear.



Ability to travel up to 50% in support of client implementations, executive reviews, and onsite activities.



Preferred



Direct experience with clinical engineering, biomedical, or managed equipment services, and understanding of what uptime means in a clinical environment.



Understanding of service contract mechanics, OEM versus ISO service trade\-offs, and operational differences between acute care and ambulatory environments.



Comfort with commercial structures behind enterprise programs: master agreements, subordinate SOWs, joinders, and phased site additions.



PMP, PgMP, or equivalent program management credential.



Who We Want to Meet

  


Act Like an Owner



You own the program plan end to end. You instrument the program against delays, unresolved dependencies, and stalled integrations. You escalate early and hold workstream leads accountable to milestones.



Accountability \& Execution, Ownership \& Commitment



Serve with Purpose



You show up as a trusted partner to your customer sponsor. You understand that every implementation is a change story. Teams are learning new systems and workflows that affect patient care. You bring rigor and empathy to that transition, holding yourself accountable for adoption outcomes.



Relationship Management, Active Listening, Clear \& Critical Thinking



Adapt to Thrive



You navigate ambiguity in large healthcare organizations with competing priorities and shifting demands. You stay flexible in approach while holding firm on what matters: customer outcomes and program health. You learn quickly and bring that learning forward.



Learning Agility, Resilience, Composure Under Pressure



Collaborate to Win



You lead without formal authority and do it well. You build credibility with Engagement Managers, technical leads, and customer stakeholders through clarity, responsiveness, and reliability. You bring people together across solution practices and customer functions. You mentor junior program managers.



Team Orientation, Influence \& Persuasion, Alignment \& Cohesion



Challenge the Status Quo



You notice when a process breaks down mid\-program and ask why. You bring that signal back to product and operations leadership. You see what would make the next program faster and smoother and say it out loud. You contribute ideas for practice improvement.



Curiosity \& Problem Solving, Continuous Improvement, Innovation

**Benefits \& Perks**


* Competitive compensation package with salary, incentives, company ownership/equity, and comprehensive benefits (401k match, health, college debt reduction, and more!)
* Career and professional development through training, coaching and new experiences.
* Hybrid culture with new \& beautiful workspaces that balance flexibility, collaboration, and productivity.
* Inclusive and diverse community of passionate professionals learning and growing together.

  


**Interested?**



We'd love to hear from you! Submit your resume and an optional cover letter explaining why you'd be a great fit.


**About PartsSource**



Since 2001, PartsSource has evolved into the leading technology and software platform for managing mission\-critical equipment, serving over half of the U.S. hospital infrastructure. Our digital systems modernize and automate the procurement of parts, services, technical support, and training for HTM professionals to efficiently and effectively maintain their mission\-critical equipment. PartsSource employs over 700 employees nationwide that committed to supporting healthcare providers and ensuring healthcare always on.



In 2021, Bain Capital invested in the business, further accelerating our growth and positive impact within the healthcare industry.


**Read more about us here:**


* PartsSource Named to Newsweek's List of the Top 200 America's Most Loved Workplaces for 2024
* PartsSource® Named Among the Top 50 Healthcare Technology Companies of 2025
* PartsSource® Named Among the Top 25 Healthcare Software Companies of 2025
* PartsSource President and CEO Philip Settimi Named to Top 50 Healthcare Technology CEO List 2025
* WSJ: Bain Capital Private Equity Scoops Up PartsSource

  


**EEO**
PartsSource, Inc., and its affiliates and subsidiaries, provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.  



Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required.

jobs.title: Onboarding Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Onboarding Support Specialist — Dental Accounting Group

We work exclusively with dental practices, handling their bookkeeping, payroll, and accounting so practice owners can focus on patients. We are hiring our first Onboarding Support Specialist, a new role dedicated entirely to giving new clients an excellent first ninety days with our firm.

**What you'll do**

You will own the new client experience from the moment the engagement letter is signed until the client is fully set up and handed to their ongoing Account Manager. You will proactively drive each onboarding forward by collecting documents, following up on missing information, setting up accounting and payroll systems, coordinating conversions from the client's previous provider, and keeping the client informed throughout the process. When an issue arises, you will take responsibility for finding the answer, coordinating the right resources, and ensuring it is resolved rather than simply passing it to someone else. You'll be the person who anticipates next steps, closes open loops, and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks during a transition that is stressful for a practice owner.

When you're not onboarding, you'll support our accounting and tax department with client records, document management, and keeping our internal processes documented and current.

**What we're looking for**

* Someone with strong communication skills (this is a client facing role)
* Two or more years in an administrative, client service, or accounting support role
* Comfort juggling several clients at different stages without losing track
* Working knowledge of QuickBooks Online and strong spreadsheet skills
* Clear, professional writing — you'll email clients directly every day
* Quick to pick up new software; we use Canopy, Gusto, ShareFile, Fathom, and others
* Careful with details and discreet with confidential financial information
* Dental or healthcare experience is a plus, as is payroll experience, but we will train the right person on the industry.

**Why this role**

This is a new position, which means you get to assist with shaping it. If you like bringing order to something that has been handled ad hoc, and you take satisfaction in a clean handoff, you will do well here.

**Requirements for Candidates**

* Minimum 3 years of customer service experience
* Dedicated remote office environment at your home
* Must be based in the United States of America

**Preferred:**

* Minimum experience of 2 years of working remotely
* Experience working in an accounting or finance department
* Foundational knowledge of accounting \& experience with QuickBooks Online

**Compensation Range**

* Salary range: $40k\-$50k DOE Plus, full benefits
* $833\+ per month in company paid health benefits
* 2 weeks PTO; moves to 3 weeks after 5 years
* In addition to PTO: 10 days of paid additional office closures \& 8 days paid holiday
* 3% safe harbor 401k company match
* Flexible work schedule

***To be considered: Must submit a resume, cover letter \& provide 3 references***

Pay: $40,000\.00 \- $50,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have a dedicated remote office environment at your home?

Experience:

* customer service: 3 years (Required)

Location:

* United States (Required)

jobs.title: Healthcare Claims Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Healthcare Claims Implementation Specialist serves as InfoMC’s primary domain authority for healthcare claims operations during new client onboarding engagements on the Incedo claims platform. This individual bridges the gap between client operational workflows and the technical capabilities of the Incedo solution, ensuring that each implementation is aligned with payer\-side business requirements, regulatory obligations, and industry standards for electronic data interchange (EDI).

The BA/SME works directly with health plan and managed care organization clients to define requirements, configure workflows, validate transaction sets, and guide teams through end\-to\-end claims lifecycle processes—from member eligibility through remittance and adjudication. The ideal candidate brings deep payer\-side experience with HIPAA\-mandated EDI transactions, CMS reporting requirements, and the operational realities of claims processing within Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and commercial health plan environments.

What the Healthcare Claims Implementation Specialist Does:

***Claims Domain Expertise \& Client Advisory***

* Serve as the internal and client\-facing subject matter expert on healthcare claims operations, EDI transaction standards, and payer\-side adjudication logic throughout the Incedo onboarding lifecycle
* Translate client payer workflows and claims processing requirements into detailed business and functional specifications for the Incedo implementation team
* Advise clients on best practices for configuring claims intake, adjudication rules, coordination of benefits (COB), appeals and grievance workflows, and remittance processing within Incedo
* Identify gaps between client legacy processes and Incedo capabilities; document and escalate to product/engineering as applicable
* Support clients in designing claims data migration strategies, including crosswalks from legacy systems and validation of historical claims data integrity

***EDI Transaction Set Knowledge \& Validation***

The BA/SME must possess hands\-on functional knowledge of the following HIPAA\-mandated ASC X12 transaction sets and their application in a payer environment:

* 834 – Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance: member eligibility file intake from CMS, employer groups, or TPAs; validation of enrollment spans, plan codes, and subscriber/dependent relationships
* 270 / 271 – Eligibility Inquiry and Response: real\-time and batch eligibility verification, configuration of response logic and benefit information, and integration with member enrollment systems
* 837P / 837I – Professional and Institutional Claims: inbound claims intake, loop and segment validation, NPI/taxonomy routing, and coordination with Incedo adjudication engine
* 835 – Healthcare Claim Payment/Advice (ERA): remittance generation, CAS segment coding, ERA reconciliation against adjudicated claims, and ERA/EFT pairing
* 276 / 277 – Claim Status Request and Response: outbound claims status inquiry workflows, 277CA acknowledgment processing, and payer\-to\-provider communication configuration
* 278 – Health Care Services Review (Prior Authorization): inbound and outbound PA request/response workflows, integration with Incedo utilization management module, and CMS\-0057\-F electronic PA compliance
* 275 – Patient Information (Additional Information to Support a Health Care Claim): receipt and routing of clinical attachments and supporting documentation submitted by providers in conjunction with claims, including coordination with Incedo adjudication workflows requiring medical records or authorization documentation
* 999 / TA1 – Functional Acknowledgment and Interchange Acknowledgment: EDI gateway configuration, acknowledgment tracking, and error\-handling workflows

***Onboarding \& Implementation Execution***

* Lead business analysis workstreams during new client onboarding, including requirements discovery sessions, workflow mapping, and gap analysis documentation
* Develop and maintain detailed business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications, data mapping templates, and EDI companion guides customized to each client’s trading partner environment
* Coordinate with the client’s EDI team and clearinghouse partners to complete end\-to\-end transaction testing for all applicable X12 transaction sets
* Facilitate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) for claims processing scenarios, ensuring adjudication outcomes align with client benefit plan configuration and state/federal requirements
* Document client\-specific configurations, workflow decisions, and known edge cases in InfoMC’s implementation knowledge base
* Partner with Engagement Managers and Technical Leads to ensure claims\-related milestones are on track, risks are escalated promptly, and client expectations are managed

***Regulatory \& Compliance Alignment***

* Maintain current knowledge of CMS regulations, HIPAA transaction and code set standards (45 CFR Part 162\), and state Medicaid agency requirements as they affect claims operations
* Advise clients on compliance with CMS\-0057\-F (electronic prior authorization), No Surprises Act (NSA) claims adjudication timelines, and applicable state prompt pay laws
* Support clients in Medicare Advantage (Part C), Medicaid managed care, and CHIP programs in configuring Incedo to meet CMS encounter data submission requirements
* Monitor and communicate updates to X12 transaction standards, ICD/CPT/HCPCS code set releases, and CMS NCCI edits that may affect client configurations

***Knowledge Sharing \& Continuous Improvement***

* Develop and maintain internal training materials, job aids, and onboarding playbooks related to claims operations and EDI workflows on the Incedo platform
* Mentor junior implementation staff on payer claims concepts, EDI troubleshooting, and client\-facing discovery techniques
* Collaborate with InfoMC’s Product and Engineering teams to communicate client\-driven enhancement requests and emerging market requirements
* Contribute to the ongoing refinement of InfoMC’s Implementation Playbook with claims\-specific best practices and lessons learned

What the Healthcare Claims BA/SME Demonstrates:

* Deep command of the end\-to\-end claims lifecycle from the payer’s perspective: member eligibility, claims intake, adjudication, COB, appeals, and remittance
* Functional mastery of HIPAA ASC X12 transaction sets (834, 837P/I/D, 835, 270/271, 276/277, 278, 999/TA1\) with the ability to read, interpret, and troubleshoot raw EDI files
* Ability to conduct structured discovery sessions with health plan operations teams, extract requirements, and translate them into actionable technical specifications
* Strong written communication skills, including the ability to produce clear BRDs, data dictionaries, and process flow diagrams
* Comfort operating in a client\-facing role across multiple concurrent engagements, managing competing priorities with minimal supervision
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to coordinate across internal teams (Implementation, Product, Engineering, QA) and external stakeholders (client IT, clearinghouses, trading partners)
* Analytical rigor and attention to detail when validating EDI transaction data, reviewing adjudication outcomes, and auditing benefit plan configurations
* Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL sufficient to support data validation and claims reporting tasks

**Qualifications**

***Required***

* Bachelor’s Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, Business, or equivalent work experience
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in a healthcare payer environment (health plan, managed care organization, TPA, or Medicare Advantage plan) in a claims operations or claims business analyst capacity
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience with HIPAA X12 EDI transactions including 834, 837P/I/D, 835, 270/271, 275, 276/277, and 278
* Experience with claims adjudication systems, clearinghouse relationships, and payer\-side EDI trading partner onboarding
* Familiarity with ICD\-10, CPT, HCPCS Level II, revenue codes, and NCCI edits in the context of claims processing
* Experience supporting software implementations or system migrations in a healthcare payer context
* Ability to travel to client sites as needed (estimated up to 20%)
* This role is not eligible for sponsorship

***Preferred***

* Experience with Medicare Advantage (Part C) or Medicaid managed care claims operations, including CMS encounter data submission
* Knowledge of CMS\-0057\-F electronic prior authorization requirements and their claims workflow implications
* Familiarity with No Surprises Act (NSA) independent dispute resolution and good faith estimate requirements
* Experience with utilization management or care management platforms that interface with claims adjudication
* CPHQ, RHIT, RHIA, or equivalent healthcare informatics certification
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
* SQL proficiency for claims data validation and ad hoc reporting
* Prior experience in a healthcare IT vendor or SaaS implementation environment

**Physical Demands / Working Conditions**

Light work: this position involves sitting, standing, and/or walking. This is a remote work environment requiring the ability to use a computer and communicate clearly by telephone and video conference. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

**Highlighted Benefits for InfoMC Team Members:**

* InfoMC is an equal opportunity employer with a generous compensation plan
* Excellent earning potential with qualifying annual bonuses
* Health, Dental, and Vision Plan
* Life insurance, short\- and long\-term disability
* 401(k) retirement savings plan
* Paid holidays and vacation
* Work from home
* Flexible schedule

Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $115,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have these qualifications? Explain your experience within.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, Business, or equivalent work experience
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in a healthcare payer environment (health plan, managed care organization, TPA, or Medicare Advantage plan) in a claims operations or claims business analyst capacity
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience with HIPAA X12 EDI transactions including 834, 837P/I/D, 835, 270/271, 275, 276/277, and 278
* Experience with claims adjudication systems, clearinghouse relationships, and payer\-side EDI trading partner onboarding
* Familiarity with ICD\-10, CPT, HCPCS Level II, revenue codes, and NCCI edits in the context of claims processing
* Experience supporting software implementations or system migrations in a healthcare payer context
* What is your desired salary expectations?

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
Onboarding Engineer – Building Controls

URIEL Management — Dallas/Fort Worth, TX (Hybrid, travel across Texas)

Full\-time \| $70,000 – $95,000 per year \+ bonus, based on experience

URIEL Management is a technology company bringing AI\-driven control to commercial buildings across Texas, backed by a 45\-year HVAC and controls contractor. Every new customer site goes through our onboarding process, from signed contract to live on our platform. We need one person who owns that process and makes sure nothing gets missed.

This job is about attention to detail. You’re the person who reads the whole email, checks the work twice, follows up before anyone has to ask, and doesn’t call something done until it’s actually done.

**Why you’ll want this job**

* You own it. Every new site runs through you. When a customer goes live on schedule with everything right, that’s your work.
* Your care shows. Customers see the results of your accuracy every day on their dashboards and reports.
* Small team, direct line to leadership. You work daily with the CEO and CTO. No bureaucracy.
* Room to grow. You’ll learn controls, networking, and program management, and grow into operations leadership as we scale.
* Controls meets AI. You’ll help connect real buildings to an AI platform, work almost nobody in this industry is doing yet.

**What you’ll do**

* Own the onboarding checklist for every new site and make sure every item is completed, verified, and recorded in our platform
* Keep the master schedule and site trackers accurate and current so anyone can see exactly where every site stands
* Confirm paperwork, site information, and customer contacts are complete before anything is scheduled
* Schedule installs with customers and installation crews, and keep everyone informed before, during, and after
* Set up new sites and customer accounts in our platform
* Support installers on install day and verify each site is fully live and correct within 48 hours
* Close out every site completely: records, photos, schedule updates, billing handoff, and customer go\-live notice
* Follow up relentlessly on anything outstanding, from customers, installers, or our own team, until it’s resolved
* Improve our checklists and processes whenever you find a gap

**You must have**

* A track record of getting the details right. You double\-check your own work, catch mistakes others miss, and finish what you start
* Experience owning a process or project with lots of moving parts: multiple sites, deadlines, and people
* Strong organization: spreadsheets, trackers, and schedules you keep current without being reminded
* Clear, professional communication by phone, email, and in person
* Working knowledge of building controls or HVAC, or a technical background you can apply to it quickly
* Comfortable with web\-based software and learning new platforms; you use AI tools in your daily work
* Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel to sites across Texas, including occasional overnights

**Nice to have**

* Building automation experience (BACnet, Trane, JCI, Siemens, Honeywell, Niagara, or similar)
* Basic IP networking
* Experience coordinating contractors or field crews
* Multi\-site rollouts for retail, restaurant, or dealership portfolios
* Project coordination or scheduling tools (Smartsheet, MS Project, or similar)

**Pay \& benefits**

* $70,000 – $95,000 per year, based on experience
* Performance bonus
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid time off and paid holidays
* Additional benefits package
* Hybrid: remote most days, site travel as rollouts require

**Apply**

Send your resume and a short note telling us about a time you caught an error before it became a problem. Apply through Indeed.

Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $95,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Roanoke, TX 76262

jobs.title: Staff Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
What You'll Do:
#### **Role Summary**


The Principal Consultant is one of Avalara's most senior and impactful practitioners in the implementation discipline. This role leads our most complex and strategically significant customer engagements, defines the methodology that scales across the practice, and serves as the go\-to escalation resource when the most challenging implementation scenarios arise. It is a practice\-shaping role for a practitioner who takes pride in setting the standard and building the team around them.

  

Avalara's implementation practice sits at the intersection of tax complexity, enterprise technology, and customer outcomes. As our customer base expands in scale, global reach, and strategic importance, enterprise customers increasingly need a trusted expert who can translate sophisticated, multi\-jurisdictional tax requirements into scalable implementation architectures \- someone who raises the bar not just within a single engagement, but across the entire practice.

#### **How This Role Elevates Avalara**


This role will:

* Set the standard for implementation excellence across ERP, POS, and eCommerce environments, establishing best practices and repeatable frameworks the broader team adopts.
* Elevate team capability by mentoring and developing senior and mid\-level specialists, raising the quality of implementation delivery across the practice.
* Reduce delivery risk for Avalara's most strategically significant customers through direct ownership of the most complex, highest\-stakes engagements.
* Drive systemic improvement by identifying patterns across customer implementations and translating them into process improvements, tooling enhancements, and scalable playbooks.
* Influence Avalara's product roadmap by representing the implementation function in cross\-functional forums with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success, closing systemic delivery gaps and driving platform improvements.
* Advance Avalara's AI\-first strategy by embedding AI\-enabled approaches into implementation methodology, discovery, solution design, and team capability development.

  


What Your Responsibilities Will Be:#### **Responsibilities**


The successful candidate will:

* Architect and deliver end\-to\-end implementations across the full suite of supported ERP and platform integrations, including Sage, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, Stripe Invoicing, NetSuite, and QuickBooks, at the highest level of complexity and customization.
* Own a portfolio of Avalara's most strategically critical customer implementations, ensuring delivery quality that sets a benchmark for the practice.
* Design and lead discovery engagements with enterprise and global customers, synthesizing complex tax workflow requirements into tailored, scalable implementation architectures.
* Identify systemic patterns across the customer portfolio and translate them into process improvements, tooling enhancements, and scalable frameworks that benefit the entire practice.
* Influence implementation methodology by recommending enhancements to playbooks, onboarding materials, training curricula, and SOPs that govern how the team operates.
* Serve as the escalation point for unresolved implementation and support challenges, providing expert guidance to senior and junior specialists.
* Partner with Implementation leadership as a thought leader on strategy, methodology evolution, and the future direction of the implementation practice.
* Represent the implementation function in cross\-functional forums with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to influence the product roadmap and resolve systemic delivery gaps.
* Mentor and develop senior and mid\-level specialists through structured coaching on implementation methodology, advanced ERP configurations, and customer engagement strategies.
* Leverage AI tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, solution design, documentation, and implementation planning across complex customer engagements.

#### **12\-Month Success Signals**


Within the first 12 months, this consultant will:

* Deliver enhanced implementation playbooks, onboarding materials, and SOPs that measurably improve delivery consistency across the team.
* Successfully own and close a portfolio of Avalara's most complex and strategically significant customer implementations at or above quality benchmarks.
* Establish at least one new methodology or framework adopted as standard practice by the broader implementation team.
* Reduce escalation volume through proactive identification of systemic implementation risks and structured root\-cause resolution.
* Influence at least one Product or Engineering priority through cross\-functional engagement backed by implementation data and customer evidence.
* Demonstrate measurable use of AI in discovery, solution design, or documentation that improves speed, consistency, or delivery quality.
* Develop senior specialists through structured coaching, with observable improvement in methodology application and customer engagement quality.

  


What You'll Need to be Successful:
#### **AI Bar Raiser Expectations**


At Avalara, Principal Consultants are expected to be AI Bar Raisers, leaders who improve how AI is applied across implementation methodology, discovery, solution design, and team capability development. This role shapes the standard for applied AI in implementation and elevates the AI capability of the consultants and teams around them.


The successful candidate will:

* Leverage approved AI tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, requirements documentation, solution design, and implementation planning across complex customer engagements.
* Identify opportunities where AI can improve delivery consistency, reduce manual effort, and accelerate customer time\-to\-value across the practice.
* Apply AI responsibly and securely, ensuring all AI\-enabled approaches align with customer requirements and Avalara's governance standards.
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in implementation quality, productivity, or customer outcomes through AI\-enabled approaches \- not occasional use.
* Share AI best practices, reusable prompts, and implementation patterns that elevate AI capability across the consulting and implementation teams.

#### **Bar Raiser Expectations**


At Avalara, we hire Bar Raisers, leaders who strengthen organizations through deeper expertise, stronger execution, and a lasting commitment to raising the standard for everyone around them. As a Principal Consultant, this role is expected to elevate implementation methodology, improve team capability, and drive better outcomes for Avalara's most important customers.


The successful candidate will:

* Hold themselves and the team to high standards of implementation quality, customer engagement, and delivery accountability.
* Mentor and develop senior and mid\-level specialists, raising the capability of the broader team through coaching, knowledge sharing, and example.
* Identify root causes across the customer portfolio and build scalable, repeatable solutions that improve the practice for everyone.
* Exercise sound judgment when navigating complex customer requirements, competing stakeholder priorities, and technical constraints.
* Influence implementation strategy, methodology, and tooling through cross\-functional engagement and data\-backed recommendations.
* Leave every engagement, playbook, process, and team they touch stronger than they found it.

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Business Administration, Accounting, Engineering, or a related discipline and 12\+ years of experience in software implementation within the B2B sector, with a demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi\-platform, enterprise\-scale deployments.
* Recognized expert in tax automation: extensive experience independently architecting and delivering implementations of tax engines, returns, and exemption certificate systems for Avalara, TaxJar, Vertex, Sovos, Sabrix, or comparable platforms.
* Deep knowledge of sales and use tax compliance, nexus rules, and multi\-jurisdictional requirements; familiarity with VAT and international tax frameworks.
* Proven expertise across ERP and platform integrations including Sage, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, NetSuite, and QuickBooks.
* Exceptional executive presence and communication skills; demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder dynamics and engage with confidence at the executive level on both customer and internal sides.

jobs.title: IT Infrastructure Architecture & Implementation
jobs.description:
1\. Organization Background

Mosaic Youth Theatre of Detroit is an award\-winning organization that empowers young people through high\-quality arts experiences and professional development. Through performance, education, and mentorship, Mosaic builds confidence, creativity, and community while amplifying youth voice. Mosaic’s mission is to create pathways to equity and opportunity through arts experiences that engage, transform, and inspire youth and communities.

2\. Project Purpose

Mosaic Youth Theatre of Detroit is seeking an experienced IT consulting firm or technology services company to assess, design, strengthen, and implement an organizational technology infrastructure that is secure, sustainable, scalable, and manageable by a small nonprofit organization.

Mosaic currently operates with limited internal IT capacity. The selected consultant will therefore be responsible for both **strategic technology architecture and practical implementation**, with an emphasis on creating systems that can be maintained by non\-technical staff after the project is complete.

The goal of this engagement is not simply to introduce new technology, but to create a cohesive and documented technology environment that improves security, organization, data integrity, collaboration, and long\-term sustainability.

**All project work, implementation, documentation, training, and handover must be completed no later than December 31, 2026\.**

3\. Scope of Services

The project will be completed in three primary phases.

Phase 1: Assessment, Architecture \& Design

The consultant will conduct an assessment of Mosaic’s existing technology environment and develop a recommended future\-state infrastructure.

Activities may include:

* Evaluate Mosaic’s existing software, hardware, accounts, file storage, communications systems, and technology workflows, with consideration for Mosaic’s Mac\-based environment.
* Assess how organizational information currently moves between systems, including communications, files, data, CRM, finance, and other core systems.
* Identify duplication, inefficiencies, security risks, access issues, and opportunities for integration.
* Develop a **current\-state logical topology** documenting Mosaic’s existing communications, files, data, accounts, and major technology systems.
* Develop a **proposed future\-state logical topology** that reflects recommended systems, relationships, permissions, security controls, and information flows.
* Design an appropriate cloud file storage structure, including:

o Folder and organizational structure

o User groups

o Access and permission levels

o Administrative controls

o Security protections

o Backup and recovery considerations

* Evaluate and recommend appropriate platforms and tools based on Mosaic’s organizational needs, budget, existing technology environment, and long\-term sustainability.
* Develop recommendations for integrating or streamlining key organizational systems.
* Present recommendations to Mosaic for review and approval before proceeding to implementation.

Phase 1 Deliverables

The consultant will provide:

1\. **Current\-State Technology Assessment**

2\. **Current\-State Logical Topology**

3\. **Future\-State IT Infrastructure Architecture**

4\. **Future\-State Logical Topology Diagram**

5\. **Cloud File Storage \& Permissions Architecture**

6\. **Technology Platform/Tool Recommendations**

7\. **Security and Access Recommendations**

8\. **Written Architecture and Systems Documentation**

The consultant will incorporate reasonable feedback from Mosaic into the final approved architecture before proceeding to implementation.

Phase 2: Implementation \& Migration

Following Mosaic’s approval of the proposed architecture, the consultant will implement the agreed\-upon infrastructure and systems.

Activities may include:

* Provision and configure the selected nonprofit cloud environment/tenant.
* Establish or coordinate appropriate relationships with long\-term IT maintenance or managed\-service providers, as needed.
* Configure organizational users, groups, permissions, and administrative structures.
* Organize and securely migrate legacy files into the approved cloud storage structure.
* Review and migrate, as appropriate, organizational domain/DNS configurations and user accounts.
* Establish appropriate account ownership and administrative access so Mosaic retains organizational control of its technology environment.
* Implement organization\-wide Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA).
* Establish appropriate device\-security baselines.
* Configure security settings and access controls consistent with the approved architecture.
* Support or lead transitions to approved replacement systems where necessary.
* Test systems and user access following implementation.
* Identify and resolve significant migration or implementation issues.
* Coordinate with existing or external technology vendors where necessary.

Phase 2 Deliverables

The consultant will provide:

1\. **Configured cloud technology environment**

2\. **Completed file and data migration**

3\. **Configured user accounts, groups, and permissions**

4\. **Domain/DNS and account configuration**

5\. **Organization\-wide MFA implementation**

6\. **Device\-security baseline**

7\. **Implemented security and access controls**

8\. **System testing and implementation documentation**

9\. **Updated final infrastructure diagram reflecting the implemented environment**

Phase 3: Documentation, Training \& Handover

A primary goal of this engagement is to ensure that Mosaic can maintain and manage the resulting technology environment after the consulting engagement ends.

Activities may include:

* Develop clear written procedures for routine technology administration.
* Create short, role\-specific video tutorials, generally under three minutes each, addressing common employee and administrative tasks.
* Develop procedures for onboarding and offboarding users.
* Document user management, permissions, account administration, file management, security practices, and other recurring administrative functions.
* Provide training to designated Mosaic staff.
* Identify responsibilities that should remain with Mosaic staff versus an external IT provider.
* Provide recommendations for ongoing technology maintenance and support.

Phase 3 Deliverables

The consultant will provide:

1\. **Administrative Handover Document**

2\. **Written IT Administration Procedures**

3\. **Employee Onboarding/Offboarding Procedures**

4\. **Security and Access Management Procedures**

5\. **Library of Short Training Videos**

6\. **Final Systems and Infrastructure Documentation**

7\. **Recommendations for Ongoing IT Maintenance**

8\. **Two weeks of post\-launch technical support**

4\. Core Project Outcomes

At the conclusion of the engagement, Mosaic expects to have:

* A clearly documented understanding of its technology environment.
* A cohesive and scalable IT infrastructure.
* An organized and appropriately secured cloud file environment.
* Clearly defined user roles, groups, and permissions.
* Organization\-wide MFA.
* Appropriate device\-security standards.
* Securely organized and migrated legacy files and accounts.
* Reduced duplication and unnecessary manual processes.
* Clear documentation of systems and workflows.
* Systems that can be administered by appropriately trained non\-technical staff.
* A sustainable process for onboarding and offboarding employees.
* A clear plan for ongoing IT maintenance and support.
* A trained internal point of contact and/or identified external IT support structure.

5\. Estimated Level of Effort \& Project Schedule

Mosaic anticipates a project period of approximately three months, beginning in September 2026\.

**All project work, implementation, documentation, training, and handover must be completed no later than December 31, 2026\.**

The **December 31, 2026 deadline is a firm project requirement**. Respondents should propose a project schedule that demonstrates how all phases and deliverables can be completed within this timeframe, including adequate time for Mosaic review, decision\-making, testing, training, and final handover.

Mosaic anticipates that this engagement will require a significant level of professional services over the four\-month project period. The estimated level of effort is provided for planning purposes only and is not intended to prescribe the consultant's staffing model, methodology, or number of hours. Respondents should propose the level of effort they believe is necessary to successfully complete the scope and deliverables by December 31, 2026\.

**Proposed Level of Effort:** Estimated hours, staffing/team structure, and allocation of effort across project phases.

6\. Consultant Qualifications

Mosaic is seeking a consulting firm with demonstrated experience in:

* IT infrastructure architecture and implementation.
* Cloud\-based technology environments.
* Systems integration and organizational technology workflows.
* Data management, security, and access controls.
* System migrations and technology transitions.
* Supporting small organizations and/or nonprofit organizations.
* Developing technology environments that can be maintained by non\-technical staff.
* Translating technical systems and concepts into clear, accessible documentation and training.

Experience with nonprofit technology environments, including platforms such as CRM systems, QuickBooks, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and similar organizational systems, is preferred.

7\. Consultant Approach

Respondents should describe their proposed approach to the engagement, including:

* How they will assess Mosaic’s current environment.
* Their approach to developing the future\-state architecture.
* How they will evaluate and recommend technology platforms.
* Their approach to migration and implementation.
* Their approach to data security and organizational access.
* How they will minimize disruption to Mosaic’s ongoing operations.
* Their approach to documentation and knowledge transfer.
* How they will ensure that systems remain manageable by a small nonprofit with limited internal IT capacity.
* How they will provide post\-launch support.
* **How they will structure the project to ensure completion of all required deliverables by December 31, 2026\.**

Mosaic is particularly interested in an approach that balances **security and technical best practices with usability, affordability, and long\-term sustainability for a small nonprofit organization.**

8\. Proposal Requirements

Interested firms should submit a brief proposal including:

1\. **Firm Overview**

o Brief description of the firm and relevant experience.

2\. **Relevant Experience**

o Examples of comparable IT infrastructure, migration, or systems\-integration projects.

o Experience with nonprofit or similarly sized organizations.

3\. **Proposed Approach**

o Description of how the firm would approach the three project phases.

4\. **Project Team**

o Identification of the individual(s) who would be responsible for the engagement and their relevant qualifications.

5\. **Timeline**

o Proposed project schedule, including anticipated start date, major milestones, dependencies, and **confirmation that all project deliverables can be completed no later than December 31, 2026**.

6\. **Deliverables**

o Confirmation that the proposed approach will address the deliverables identified in this Scope of Work.

7\. **Fees**

o Proposed project fee or fee structure.

o Identification of any anticipated additional costs, software, licensing, migration, or third\-party expenses.

o Payment schedule tied to project milestones or deliverables.

8\. **References**

o At least two references for comparable projects, preferably involving small organizations or nonprofits.

9\. Budget \& Payment

Mosaic anticipates a project budget based on the scope and level of effort described above. Respondents should provide a **total project cost and proposed payment schedule** rather than an hourly rate alone.

If the firm proposes an hourly or time\-and\-materials structure, the proposal should identify the anticipated total hours, hourly rates, and a not\-to\-exceed project amount.

Any work outside the approved Scope of Work must receive written approval from Mosaic before additional fees are incurred.

10\. Project Management \& Communication

The selected consultant will work primarily with Mosaic’s Deputy Director and will coordinate with other staff as necessary to assess systems, implement changes, test functionality, and conduct training.

The consultant will provide regular project updates and promptly communicate any significant risks, delays, scope changes, security concerns, or issues requiring Mosaic’s decision or approval.

Because the project has a firm **December 31, 2026 completion deadline**, the consultant is expected to identify potential schedule risks promptly and work collaboratively with Mosaic to address them.

11\. Ownership \& Access

All organizational data, files, accounts, domains, documentation, diagrams, procedures, training materials, and other work products created or configured as part of this engagement shall remain accessible to and under the organizational control of Mosaic Youth Theatre of Detroit.

The consultant shall not establish systems in which Mosaic is dependent upon the consultant for continued access to its own organizational data, accounts, domains, or administrative credentials.

At project completion, the consultant will provide Mosaic with the information and administrative access necessary for Mosaic and/or its future IT provider to maintain the implemented environment.

12\. Success Criteria

The engagement will be considered substantially complete when the agreed\-upon infrastructure has been implemented, required data and accounts have been migrated or otherwise addressed, security controls have been established, documentation and training materials have been delivered, and Mosaic has received the administrative access and knowledge necessary to operate and maintain the resulting environment.

**All required project deliverables must be completed and handed over to Mosaic no later than December 31, 2026\.**

Any material exceptions or outstanding issues will be documented and agreed upon by Mosaic and the consultant as part of the final project handover.

jobs.title: EHR Certified Systems Analyst II (Behavioral Health)
jobs.description:
Located in the metropolitan area of Sacramento, the Adventist Health corporate headquarters have been based in Roseville, California, for more than 40 years. In 2019, we unveiled our WELL\-certified campus \- a rejuvenating place for associates systemwide to collaborate, innovate and connect.
  

  

Adventist Health Roseville and shared service teams have access to enjoy a welcoming space designed to promote well\-being and inspire your best work.


Job Summary:


Adventist Health Roseville is seeking an EHR Certified Systems Analyst II (Behavioral Health) for a full\-time position on 8\-hour day shifts. This remote role may require up to 25% travel. We are seeking a qualified professional to support our team and stakeholders while working remotely.


Performs various duties relating to information systems applications including the design, build, implementation, support, and testing of computer software and related processes. Works with project and support teams to ensure appropriate development, training, support, and evaluation of major computer applications.


Job Requirements:


Education and Work Experience:


* Associate's/Technical Degree or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Required
* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Preferred
* Three healthcare IT application/technical experience or equivalent: Required
* Two years’ applicable Epic application experience: Preferred
Licenses/Certifications:


* Epic Certification/Accreditation in area of responsibility: Required
Essential Functions:


* Maintains moderately complex system software utilizing established standards and departmental protocols, to meet user requests/specifications. Evaluates user requests for special enhancements to system software. Works with customers to gather specifications for the purchase, development, and installation of system software. Maintains service level agreements with various end\-user departments and enterprise business units.
* Coordinates analysis of documentation and workflows in departments, and designs/redesigns system components to support appropriate workflows. Assists in analyzing existing methods and developing alternatives to increase operations and production efficiency. Performs a needs assessment for complex workflows, customers, and/or clinical/revenue areas. Analyzes and documents reporting needs of end users. Identifies potential process and/or department\-specific risks and assists in strategies to mitigate or resolve them.
* Develops and follows project work plans. Leads project meetings and works cooperatively with team members to coordinate assigned duties with the overall program and related projects. Researches, documents, and facilitates resolution to issues reported by end\-users. Tests system software per checklist guidelines and participates in the development of test scenarios. Collaborates with technical teams to define hardware/network requirements and to research and problem\-solve technical issues.
* Presents training to a variety of audiences. Ensures that system documentation is current and available to the customer and that customers are educated as to where to find it. Assesses how users are progressing with their use of system applications and assists with optimization training to further develop user proficiency, efficiency, and satisfaction. Leads optimization activities to ensure staff effectively use the systems.
* Handles ongoing on call duties for one or more applications which generate Incidents outside of business hours. Provides on call support as needed of the most critical applications. Troubleshoots and resolves system issues escalated by the help desk. As needed, up to 25%, travel on site to provide support during go\-live events and other work\-related occasions. Travel could occur during standard off\-hours support times.
* Performs other job\-related duties as assigned.
Organizational Requirements:


Adventist Health is committed to the safety and wellbeing of our associates and patients. Therefore, we require that all associates receive all required vaccinations as a condition of employment and annually thereafter, where applicable. Medical and religious exemptions may apply.
  

  

Adventist Health participates in E\-Verify. Visit https://adventisthealth.org/careers/everify/ for more information about E\-Verify. By choosing to apply, you acknowledge that you have accessed and read the E\-Verify Participation and Right to Work notices and understand the contents therein.
